newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's IGCP rejects bids at variable bond sale.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's IGCP rejects bids at variable bond sale.

text.p: Portugal's Institute for Public Credit Management (IGCP) said it rejected all bids at its offer on Tuesday of 25 billion escudos of variable-rate, seven-year bonds.

An IGCP spokesman said that demand totalled 41.6 billion escudos, with the maximum price bid being 9,942 and the minimum 9,850 escudos. The weighted average of the bids was 9,906.90 for 10,000 escudos nominal value bonds.
At the last such sale on June 17, the IGCP placed five billion escudos at an average 9,936.4 escudos.
The variable rate bonds are indexed to the six-month Lisbor, less 25 basis points and pay a first coupon of 5.4375 percent.
